about: click_cell on a warp portal's cell (issue #1252): Geffen's tower door (geffen 120,114, a 3 x 2 portal on flat ground) seen from five cells south. A real click on a portal walks to the ground under the pointer, so click_cell on the portal's own cell and on one beside it walks there and the warp takes the player into gef_tower. Main refuses both cells with "is covered" (the portal's hit box), the player stays in Geffen and the second expect fails. The shots: the door before, the tower after.
